Title: Prayer of Azariah in the Furnace

Verses.3:
Blessed are You, Lord, God of our ancestors! [*]
	Your name is worthy of praise and glory forever!
Verses.4:
For You are just in all You have done. [t]
	All Your works are true, and Your ways right, [*]
	and all Your judgements are true.
Verses.6:
For we have sinned and, in our disobedience, turned away from You. [*]
	In all things we have failed.
Verses.11:
For Your name's sake, do not abandon us forever [*]
	or break Your covenant with us.
Verses.12:
Do not withhold Your mercy from us, [t]
	for the sake of Abraham Your friend, [*]
	Isaac Your servant, and Israel Your holy one.
Verses.13:
You promised them as many descendants as stars in the heavens [*]
	or the grains of sand on the seashore.
Verses.14:
But now, Lord, we are fewer than any nation, [*]
	and are the most humiliated in all the world because of our sins.
Verses.15:
We are left without a ruler, prophet, or leader. [t]
	No place for burnt offerings, or sacrifices. [*]
	No place for gifts or incense.
There is no place to make an offering before You, [*]
	so we may find Your mercy.
Verses.16:
But welcome us with our broken hearts and humbled spirits. [*]
	We beg You to accept us as if every burnt offering were made.
As if thousands of burnt offerings were made, [*]
Verses.17:
accept our repentance as a sacrifice in Your presence today.
May we follow You without reservation. [*]
	For those who trust in You will never be put to shame.
Verses.18:
And now, with our whole hearts, we follow You, [*]
	we fear You, and we seek Your presence.
